title: Persona Config
description: Manage AI persona settings and character configurations
createNewDesc: Describe the character you want, AI will automatically generate persona settings
createNewManuallyDesc: Directly enter persona name and content
personaQueryPlaceholder: Describe the character you want, e.g., "I need a Kaneki Ken character"
copyConfirmMessage: Duplicate persona "{name}"? A copy will be created with a number appended to the name.
deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete persona "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
editPersonaAriaDesc: Edit this persona's description, configuration and media assets
imagePreviewAriaDesc: View full-size image in a popup window
confirmSaveMessage: Are you sure you want to save changes to "{name}"?
confirmSaveWithConflict: Save changes to "{name}"? This will release the global scope currently held by "{current}".
editGroupsDesc: Edit the group ID list associated with this persona
groupsPlaceholder: Enter group IDs, separated by commas
invalidImageType: Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, JPEG)
invalidAudioType: Please select a valid audio file (MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, FLAC)
supportedAudioFormats: Supported formats: MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, FLAC
personaSettingsHint: How this persona addresses the owner, and what it says on failures. Empty values use framework defaults.
scopeGlobalDesc: Enabled for all groups and DMs
globalConflictMessage: "{current}" already occupies a global scope. Set "{new}" to this scope and automatically release "{current}"?
globalConflictHint: "{name}" already occupies a global scope and will be released on save
noPersonaEnabledWarning: No persona is currently enabled. AI will not function properly. Please enable at least one persona.
specificOnlyWarning: Only specific groups can access AI. Only the following groups can use AI features: {groups}
noPersonaAtAllWarning: No persona exists, AI features will be unavailable
keywordsPlaceholder: Enter keyword and press Enter to add
keywordsHint: When group messages contain these keywords, mention response mode will be triggered
asideHint: After a command reply is sent, add one line at the probability for image-only, text-only, or mixed replies. 0 never adds a line. 1 always does. A miss still writes the command and reply into the current session.
asideAllowToolsHint: The comment may look up data and read the plugin directory that handled the command.
asideBadgeHint: Percent: image only · text only · mixed
toolNamesHint: These tools are assembled directly every turn — they skip vector recall and consume no recall budget. Framework always-mounted tools are checked by default; add anything else you want pinned.
capabilityAgentsHint: All selected by default. Uncheck to exclude. Newly added plugin agents stay included automatically.
enabledToolsHint: Controls which plugins' tools enter this persona's vector recall pool; the number in parentheses is the plugin's tool count. All selected by default (every tool can be recalled semantically). Unchecking a plugin means its tools are neither recalled nor findable via find_tools. Framework tools (core) and the always-mounted tools in the Explicit Tool Allowlist are unaffected.
toolPresetHint: A preset is a shortcut for Enabled Tools on the right: picking a tier replaces which plugins are covered.
presetAllDesc: All plugin tools can be recalled semantically
presetLeanDesc: Keep only built-in capabilities; all plugin tools off
presetChatDesc: Recall no plugin tools; use always-mounted ones only
presetCustomHint: Custom configuration (outside the three presets) — fine-tune below.
enabledToolsSummaryAll: All {count} tools can be recalled semantically
enabledToolsSummarySome: {count} tools can be recalled ({excluded} plugins excluded)
listExcludeHint: Checked = this plugin's tools stay out of the vector recall pool.
addModePrompt: Browse by plugin, or type to filter. Checked tools become always-mounted.
scopePanelHint: Act where the problem shows up: turn off this tool's plugin, or pin the tool as always-mounted.
scopePluginToggleTitle: Toggle whether this plugin's tools enter the vector recall pool
builtinPersonaWarning: The bundled persona Sayu is rewritten from the program on every start. Copy it before editing.
promptBuiltinWarning: The default system-prompt group is rewritten from the program on every start. Create or copy a group to edit it.
promptCreateDesc: Copy every prompt from the default group. The new group can be edited.
promptEditHint: Edit every system prompt in this group. {{name}} is filled in before the text is sent.
promptTokenSummon: Type @ or / to insert a tag this field can use. Choose with the arrow keys or the mouse, press Enter to insert, and press Esc to dismiss.
promptSaveFailed: Failed to save the prompt group
promptCreateFailed: Failed to create the prompt group
promptDeleteFailed: Failed to delete the prompt group
activePromptGroupEmpty: No persona is enabled, so no system prompt group is in use.
chatStyleHint: 0 to 100. This sets how many bubbles one turn may send, and the lengths that still equal the template default. After saving, every session of this persona uses the new length.
speechSoftHint: Fills the suggested-length tag. {count} follows the speech intensity. Any other number stays as written when the text is sent.
placeholderResolvedLoading: Loading the values filled in for enabled personas.
placeholderResolvedMissed: Could not load the values for enabled personas.
